_comment: Offline provenance oracle for the llms_txt fixtures. RegistryClient.from_fixture() treats any name not listed here as NOT existing, so every package/domain a fixture expects to be real must appear. 'provenance_urls' feeds the origin_aligned / conflicting / unverified classification (a declared host is checked against the 'dns' table too); omit it to get 'unverified'. This file is a point-in-time snapshot, not a timeless fact - results still carry observed_at.
